paragraphs: Note for judges: This is the original Void Tactics frontend repository, submitted with its full commit history. The contracts are submitted the same way (briandoyle81/void-tactics-contracts). Everything described under "What's New" below was committed on or after 2026-09-14, the hackathon start date. The first commit in the hackathon window is a62c052 (2026-09-18); everything up to and including 719cd33 (2026-09-08) predates it. Run git log --since=2026-09-14 to see exactly what was built during the event. Work from a short-lived intermediate copy of this repo (void-tactics-fe-eth-ny-26) was…
Live Deployment: Frontend Repo: Contracts Repo:

Void Tactics is a turn-based tactical space combat game where players build fleets of NFT ships and fight on a 17×11 grid. Every move and every outcome is resolved on-chain. The frontend is a Next.js 16 App Router application (wagmi, viem, TanStack Query and Tailwind) talking directly to EVM contracts on Base Sepolia.

requirements.text: It's a scripted battle on the real game board, voiced by Adjutant Bosch, and needs no account or wallet.
Requires .env with RPC URLs, Dynamic API keys, the ship minter private key and DATABASEURL.
